the probe compiles and links from libwebp.pc and libwebpmux.pc alone with -Wl,--fatal-warnings: libwebp.pc Requires libsharpyuv (libsharpyuv.pc ships), so the encoder's SharpYuvInit / SharpYuvConvert / SharpYuvGetConversionMatrix resolve (1.6.0-2's libwebp.pc had only -lwebp: NEGATIVE.md)
